signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Use your account's email and password.
signIn.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.

validation.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email, for example name@company.com.

errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Incorrect email or password. Check them and try again.
errors.INVALID_MFA_CODE: The code is invalid or expired. Check it and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Can't reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.REQUIRES_RECENT_LOGIN: For your security, sign in again to continue.
errors.NOT_SIGNED_IN: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.AUTH_FAILED: We couldn't sign you in right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.WEAK_PASSWORD: This password is too weak. Choose a longer one.
errors.INVALID_PHONE_NUMBER: Invalid phone number. Use the international format, starting with +.
errors.EMAIL_ALREADY_IN_USE: An account with this email already exists. Sign in with it or reset the password.
errors.ACCOUNT_CREATION_DISABLED: Account creation is turned off in this app. Ask whoever manages it for help.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.description: Confirm it's you with your account's second factor.
mfa.factorLegend: How do you want to confirm?
mfa.codeHintTotp: Enter the 6 digits from your authenticator app.
mfa.codeHintSms: Enter the 6 digits we texted you.

signOut.failed: You're signed out on this device, but we couldn't end the session on the server. If you use other devices, sign out of all of them in Profile › Sessions.

invite.title: Organization invitation
invite.signInTitle: Sign in to see the invitation
invite.signInDescription: Use the account of the email that received the invitation.
invite.createTitle: Create your account to accept the invitation
invite.createDescription: Use the email that received the invitation. Once the account exists, you'll see the invitation and can accept it.
invite.missingTokenDescription: Open the full link you received. If it keeps happening, ask for a new invitation.

signUp.title: Create account
signUp.description: Once your account exists, create an organization or accept an invitation.
signUp.closedDescription: Ask whoever manages your organization for an invitation. The link arrives by email and lets you create the account.

resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.description: Enter your account email. We'll send you a link to create a new password.
resetPassword.sent: If an account uses {email}, we sent it a link to create a new password. The link expires soon; check your spam folder too.
